// A fixture, not compiled source: the .go.txt suffix keeps it out of the build
// while parser.ParseFile still reads it with real file names and real line
// numbers. TestExecConsentFindingNamesFileLineAndRemedy needs both, because the
// anchors the finding prints are the whole of its usefulness.
//
// It holds exactly ONE ungated, unmarked spawn. The marked one above it is
// there so "exactly one finding" is a precision claim as well as a recall one.

package fixture

import "os/exec"

//dross:exec-exempt git rev-parse resolves a ref and cannot reach repo-authored code
var head = exec.Command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD")

var build = exec.Command("go", "build", "./...")
